description: Create the metadata of an IoT Central application. The usual pattern to modify a property is to retrieve the IoT Central application metadata and security metadata, and then combine them with the modified values in a new body to update the IoT Central application.

operations.description: Create or update the metadata of an IoT Central application. The usual pattern to modify a property is to retrieve the IoT Central application metadata and security metadata, and then combine them with the modified values in a new body to update the IoT Central application.
